Question: A 2720-g (6-lb) female newborn delivered at 35 weeks’ gestation starts vomiting and becomes inconsolable 48 hours after birth. The newborn has not passed her first stool yet. Which of the following is the most likely additional laboratory finding?

opb. Increased chloride concentration in alveolar fluid
opc. Increased serum calcium concentration
opd. Increased bicarbonate concentration in pancreatic secretions
ope. Increased sodium concentration in sweat
